content.title: NASA is sending people back to the moon. Here’s why they aren’t landing | CNN
content.text: Here are 3 reasons NASA can’t yet land humans on the moon again Here are 3 reasons NASA can't yet land humans on the moon again For the first time since the 1970's, NASA is sending a crew to the moon, but the astronauts won't set foot on the surface.
